items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, George McCullin, he was the son of the old George McCullin, wasn't he? ... [INTERVIEWEE] The dad was a trumpet player too.

ctx.x: Half brother. Now, Alvin's right brother.
Well, George McCullin, he was the son of the old George McCullin, wasn't he? Yeah, that's right.
The dad was a trumpet player too. Yeah. That's the old man, he used to live on Louisiana Avenue, which when he lived there.
